messages:
Soojin Lee: We need to lock timing for launch announcement + internal enablement for the marketplace refresh. Constraint: AWS says we *might* get final approval EOW, GCP review still in progress. Proposing we pick a go-live window and then do a 24h internal heads-up once we have “approved + scheduled” from both.

Soojin Lee: Draft schedule idea (PT):
- T-5 business days: Sales/SE/CS enablement (30 min) + send one-pager/FAQ
- T-2: publish docs pages + final copy/screenshots in partner portals
- T-0: listings go live + announce internally + lightweight external (blog + LinkedIn)

Camila Reyes: I’m good with that structure. Key: no external announcement until listings are actually live in both places. We can still do internal enablement earlier (non-public links ok).

Ben Carter: +1. From attribution POV, I need at least 48h to set up UTMs + HubSpot routing rules for “AWS Marketplace” vs “GCP Marketplace” sources. If we announce and traffic hits dead ends, we lose signal.

Connor O'Brien: Release/launch mechanics question: are we planning a single “launch day” for both AWS+GCP, or stagger if one gets stuck in review?

Soojin Lee: Preference is single day. But if one marketplace slips more than ~1 week, I’d rather not hold the other hostage. We can message as “now available in AWS Marketplace” and follow with GCP once live.

Camila Reyes: Agree. Let’s plan for one day but build contingency copy for staggered. We should avoid a “big splash” until both are live.

Jordan Blake: From field: a lot of procurement deals are waiting on AWS specifically. If AWS is live first, we should at least let Sales know immediately + share the direct listing link so they can move paper. External marketing can wait.

Elliot Price: Docs timing: I can publish AWS/GCP onboarding pages under an unlinked URL (or behind nav flag) earlier for internal review. But for public, I’d like to flip nav + redirects same day the listings are live so customers don’t land on half-finished pages.

Dev Patel: Support readiness: I need a firm date for when we start seeing tickets. If the listings go live on a Friday, we’ll get weekend tickets with no coverage. Please avoid Friday go-live.

Rafael Mendes: +1 on avoiding Friday. Also if we’re flipping entitlement/provisioning changes, I want at least 24h of dashboards running in prod with the new counters before we drive traffic.

Soojin Lee: OK, constraints noted:
- Avoid Friday go-live
- Need 24h monitoring warm-up
- Need 48h for UTM/HubSpot updates

Soojin Lee: Suggestion: target **Tuesday 10am PT** for “go live” (best case), with internal enablement the prior Thursday.

Camila Reyes: Tuesday 10am PT works. I’d also like a Monday internal reminder in #sales + #support with the final links and what changed.

Ben Carter: Tuesday 10am PT is great. I can have tracking ready by Friday EOD if I get the final URLs (or even placeholders) for:
- AWS listing
- GCP listing
- Docs: /docs/marketplace/aws + /docs/marketplace/gcp

Elliot Price: I can provide the docs URLs now (they’ll 404 until publish unless we stage). We can use:
- https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace/aws
- https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace/gcp
We’ll publish + add to nav on launch day.

Connor O'Brien: For the internal enablement session, who’s presenting what? I can MC and cover “launch checklist + where to watch dashboards,” but need owners for messaging + FAQ.

Soojin Lee: I’ll cover: positioning + what’s new in SKUs + talk track for “why marketplace.” Markus Klein isn’t in this thread but I’ll ask him to do 5 min on common buyer questions.

Jasmine Liu: CS can cover escalation path + what info to collect from customers (marketplace account ID, org ID, region, entitlement status). Dev/Support: can you confirm the “first-line” runbook is ready?

Dev Patel: Yep. We’ll have macros ready + the troubleshooting guide pinned in #support. I just need the final “known issues / edge cases” list (org linking + region mismatch) so we can set expectations.

Rafael Mendes: I’ll post the SRE monitoring link + thresholds in the enablement doc. If we see entitlement lag >15 min sustained or webhook failure spike, we pause comms and page Eng on-call.

Camila Reyes: External announcement: let’s keep it simple.
- LinkedIn post from company page
- short blog/news post (optional)
No press release. No big email blast until we’ve seen stable onboarding for ~72h.

Soojin Lee: Works for me. Proposed comms plan:
- Internal enablement: Thu 1:00–1:30pm PT
- Internal “go-live tomorrow” reminder: Mon 2pm PT
- Go-live: Tue 10am PT (once both live; if only AWS live, we do internal + Sales note, no external)
- External LinkedIn: Tue 11am PT (only if both live + docs live + monitoring green)

Ben Carter: :thumbsup: I’ll prep two sets of UTMs (aws vs gcp). Also please don’t change the final listing URLs last-minute without a heads up.

Connor O'Brien: I’ll put a calendar hold for Thu enablement + build a 1-page “launch checklist” doc for day-of: copy, docs, support, monitoring, partner portal screenshots.

Elliot Price: If Tuesday is the target, I need final approval on security wording for the docs FAQ by Monday morning.

Camila Reyes: Loop in Aisha/Marcus on that separately. For this thread: are we aligned that **Tuesday 10am PT** is the default launch window, with staggered contingency?

Jordan Blake: Aligned. Also request: as soon as AWS is approved (even before go-live) can we share the expected listing name + SKU names internally? AEs are getting asked “what do I buy?”

Soojin Lee: Yes. Once we have final approved names from partner portal, I’ll post in #sales + #solutions-engineering with the SKU table + “which to use when.”

Dev Patel: +1. That’ll cut tickets too (wrong SKU -> wrong expectations).

Rafael Mendes: All good. Just please ensure we don’t publish the docs nav before the entitlements pipeline is stable.

Camila Reyes: Great. Decision captured:
- Target go-live: Tue 10am PT (avoid Friday)
- Internal enablement: Thu prior
- External announcement only when both marketplaces live + docs live + monitoring green
Soojin, can you update the launch brief doc with this schedule?

Soojin Lee: Yep, updating launch brief + posting a summary in #general once Connor confirms calendar holds. :white_check_mark:
